title: French Crepes with Tomato Filling
description: Delicate French crepes filled with a fresh and tangy tomato filling, perfect for a light brunch.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine diced tomatoes, chopped herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
2. Lay a crepe flat and spoon a tablespoon of the tomato mixture in the center.
3. Fold the crepe in half over the filling and serve immediately.
4. Repeat with the remaining crepes and filling.
5. Serve warm, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
